Inline markers inside a code span stay literal content

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p><code>a<em>b</em><ins>c</ins></code></p>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
